fulltext: IT之家 9 月 24 日消息，华为 MatePad Air Z 平板今日 10:08 正式预售，限时优惠价 2799 元起，9 月 29 日 10:08 正式开售，官网现已公布新品配置信息。
华为 MatePad Air Z 系列平板提供珊瑚橙、海岛蓝、星云粉、深空灰、皓月银配色，搭载麒麟 T93SD 处理器、HarmonyOS 7.0 系统，配备 12 英寸 LCD 屏，最高支持 144Hz 屏幕刷新率，分辨率 2800 × 1840 像素，屏占比 88%。
该机前置摄像头 800 万像素，后置摄像头 5000 万像素，配备 10100 mAh（典型值）电池，机身尺寸为 270.50 mm × 183.55 mm × 5.9 mm，重量约 555g（含电池）。
IT之家询问华为商城官方客服获悉，MatePad Air Z 悦享款标准版与 MatePad Air Z 标准版都搭载麒麟 T93SD 芯片，不同的地方在于标配的充电器及后置 LED 闪光灯。
MatePad Air Z 悦享款标准版包装内标配 40W 充电器，不支持后置 LED 闪光灯，MatePad Air Z 标准版包装内标配 66W 充电器，支持后置 LED 闪光灯。

fulltext: IT之家 9 月 24 日消息，台媒《电子时报》当地时间今日报道称，台积电 (TSMC) 已确定自 2027 年 1 月起进一步上调晶圆出货价格。
报道指出，此轮涨价的具体涨幅依工艺节点而定，2nm、3nm 等先进制程涨幅相对较高，成熟 / 特殊制程则逐案差异化调整，整体约为 3~5%。
半导体合同制造市场整体呈现供不应求态势，这一情况在与 AI 需求强绑定的先进制程上最为突出，供电、驱动等外围芯片的产能也连带吃紧。这是台积电等业者调升价格的底气。
另一方面，TSMC Arizona 等海外站点前期建设成本高昂。台积电提升定价也有助于缓冲美国等地晶圆厂逐步量产带来的毛利率稀释。
主芯片、外围芯片、内存、存储以及 PCB、载板等元器件成本的持续集体上涨，也意味着终端的科技硬件产品面临更大的定价压力。

cards.title: Meta靠自研Manus翻身！股价一夜暴涨11%，登顶苹果商店，增速反超ChatGPT
cards.summary: 美国也开启了全民养虾狂潮
fulltext: 美国也开启了全民养虾狂潮
谁能想到，大半年过去，美国也开启了全民养虾狂潮。
Meta版OpenClaw——Meta Muse，杀疯了。
需要取消保险？
Muse拨打客服电话、扯皮、搞定。
怒省700刀。
车险被坑了？
有老哥去健身房撸铁，随手把现有的车险账单丢给Muse，让它去全网找更便宜的投保方案。
15分钟后一组卧推刚练完，Muse直接帮他把保费砍掉了1156美元。
需要退货？
起送，Muse要求商家全额退款+上门取件，成了。
用户甚至都忘了自己之前提过这事，直到快递小哥敲门才想起来。
太多了太多了，完全说不完……
然后，我转头看了眼北美App Store——
登顶了。
而且只花了13天。。。
非常恐怖的速度，横向对比的话，已经超过了2022年末刚上线时的ChatGPT。
华尔街反应更能说明问题，直接给跪了——
Meta股价周一暴涨11%，创下近一年来最大单日涨幅，市值一夜重回巅峰。
泪目了。
Coding大战打得如火如荼，大半年无人在意的扎总，终于回光返照了一次。
网友直呼：这才是真正的OpenCalw。
所以，让全网疯狂、让Meta股价起飞的Muse，究竟是个什么物种？
这是Meta超级智能实验室（MSL）端出来的个人AI智能体。
以前的各种AI助手，本质上还是个「陪聊机器人」。
你发一句话，它回一段文字；遇到需要具体操作的事情，依然得自己一步一步手动去点。
Coding Agent终于是能干活了，但问题是，手机上真的很难用啊…
Remote老连接不稳地，而且对C端用户真的很不友好。
平时生活中订飞机票，找个餐馆啥的，谁用Codex啊。。。
我觉得，目前做的最好的真就只有你豆姐。
生态太舒服了，还有云电脑，可以直接在飞书里安排日程。
而且，如果你买了最新款豆包手机，甚至能通过MCP或GUI拿到移动端APP的权限，让豆姐帮你叫曹操出行去高铁站。
Muse也是这个方向的产品，个人助手定位，专攻邮件、出行、网购等生活场景。
好的产品会自己说话。
刚发布的时候，Muse还没啥声量，今天一检索关键词，网友已经玩疯了。
有老哥直接让Muse给Xfinity打电话，帮自己把网费砍下来。
Muse一路自己闯过电话菜单，成功接通真人客服。中间碰到一条自己读不了的短信验证码，还直接把用户本人拉进电话，三方现场连线。
Muse Agent、用户本人，以及一位完全不知道自己正在和AI Agent聊天的Xfinity客服，三方在线砍价。
最后一通电话下来，每个月账单省了85.30美元，而且这个价格直接锁定5年。
算下来，累计能省大约5118美元。
更离谱的是，用户事后还能直接看到Muse和Xfinity客服完整的通话记录。
AI Agent到底是怎么跟真人客服拉扯、谈价、砍账单的，全程透明。
还有更狠的，直接让Muse去和电信运营商真人客服对线。
一位网友让Muse给AT&T打电话，给自己名下两套房的光纤宽带砍价。
Muse不仅自己拨通客服，顺畅穿透了烦人的人工语音菜单，还在核验完机主身份后，精准转接到负责老用户挽留的专线客服。
直到这时，Muse才把电话切回给主人。最终24个月怒省1920美元，顺便还提醒主人把付款方式改成银行自动扣款，每月能再省10美元。
坐飞机遇到改签扯皮？
丢给Muse就完事了。它在后台自己听着漫长的等待音乐排队，等真正接通人工客服，立刻回拨给主人。
是的，这就是个人Agent的能做的事情。
这，才是Agent该有的样子。
不过，你们北美版本也太过时了啊，中国区大半年前就走完领鸡蛋的流程了。。。
但是，AI圈的事情向来是有人欢喜有人愁。
正当网友们玩得不亦乐乎时，一盆冷水当头浇了下来。
拔网线的正是电商巨头亚马逊。
有用户在测试Muse的代购功能时发现，只要向亚马逊发送指令，就会立刻撞墙，屏幕上直接跳出一条冰冷的警告：
未经授权的AI智能体持续访问，违反了亚马逊用户协议。
但也没办法，是Meta自己的锅，此前根本没有获得亚马逊的授权许可，先斩后奏这块。
所以亚马逊的态度非常坚决：只要检测到是Muse，直接全面拦截。
但老登亚马逊也不是第一次这么干了。。。
此前Perplexity推出购物智能体时，亚马逊就同样毫不客气地对簿公堂，坚决把AI代购挡在门外。
毕竟确实碰到利益红线了。
表面上看，巨头搬出来的是数据安全和用户协议；往深处看，根子上全都是商业模式的命根子。
传统电商平台是怎么赚大钱的？
靠的是把你留在App里不停地刷推荐页，靠的是商家在搜索结果里竞价买广告位，靠的是你在挑选比价时产生的海量曝光和冲动消费。
一旦Muse这种智能体接管了购物流程，用户根本不需要打开电商网站看广告，只要给Agent下个指令，AI直接去后台比价、抓取最优解、下单结账一条龙搞定。
这样一来，巨头苦心经营多年的流量漏斗和广告变现体系，瞬间就面临被击穿的风险。
现阶段Agent落地的真正上限，往往不是模型本身够不够聪明，而是会不会触动存量巨头的商业利益。
不过，咱就是说，这集国内用户早就看过了。
豆包手机当年遭遇的生态壁垒，如今在北美市场几乎原样重演了一遍。。。
但生态巨头阵营里也并非铁板一块。
就在亚马逊全力封杀的同时，独立电商巨头Shopify却反其道而行之。
Shopify首席执行官Tobias Lütke周一公开宣布，平台将全面接入Muse，允许Meta的个人智能体在平台内自主完成购物和付款结算：
为人们提供一种轻松愉快的购物和结账方式。
一边是守着广告模式严防死守，一边是拥抱智能体寻找新增量，这场关于流量与入口的博弈，才刚刚拉开序幕。
聊完了外部的风波，咱们再把目光拉回Muse本身。
从Muse发布的第一天起，很多深谙开源社区的极客就总觉得哪里不对劲：
这小家伙，怎么横看竖看都透着一股熟悉的小龙虾味儿？
AI应用联合创始人Ansh Nanda直接在X上发文吐槽：
兄弟们，Muse简直就是给普通人用的OpenClaw。它骨子里根本就是OpenClaw。
在随后的实测对话中，连Muse自己都在聊天中自爆了。说自身的系统文件架构与OpenClaw绝非巧合，甚至用「高度吻合」来形容。
各路开发者随即化身列文虎克，把Muse扒了个底朝天。大家发现：
1、工作区文件结构和命名规则，几乎跟OpenClaw一模一样。
2、用来定义智能体人格、语调、价值观、行为边界的核心配置文件SOUL.md，内容几乎原封不动。
3、底层的自主循环逻辑、心跳检测机制，处处都是OpenClaw的影子。
神了，光明正大地抄啊。。。
不过，面对全网的围观与对比，Meta的回应倒是挺好。
Meta超级智能实验室（MSL）产品负责人、前GitHub首席执行官Nat Friedman现身评论区，直接大大方方承认了这一点：
我们从零开始构建了Muse，但作为一款产品，它绝对在很大程度上受到了OpenClaw的启发。
在1月份使用OpenClaw之后，我为MSL团队购买了数百台Mac mini，我们中的许多人都深深喜欢上了使用OpenClaw。
并且毫不吝啬地对原作者表达致敬，给到了Credit：
Peter Steinberger是个天才，他的框架从一开始就具有开创性。我认为很多人都受到了它的启发。
我们对Muse的目标是打造类似OpenClaw的产品，使其安全、可靠、易于使用，并能推广扩展到数十亿人。
但还是有网友追着杀：你致敬归致敬，连SOUL.md命名都照着抄是啥意思啊，纯拿来主义？
Nat Friedman的回答又一次让我仿佛看见椅子爆炸：
因为我们认为Peter——全对！
这番坦白在社交网络上引发了热烈讨论。
有网友略带嘲讽地指出，这是Meta传统技能再现，当年借鉴Snapchat的Stories格式也是同样的操作。
不过，更多开源社区的开发者还是站在了Meta这一边。
OpenClaw本来就是开源项目，它的设计范式已经被证明是目前极优秀的Agent架构。
Meta至少没像有些公司一样，掩耳盗铃，被发现了再拿钱封口。
说实话，我觉得，让Meta来延续这件事，或许真的是OpenClaw最好的归宿。
过去几个月，极客们在本地终端里玩得不亦乐乎。
但对于数十亿普通用户来说，配置环境、管理Token、本地跑Docker这些门槛，你Peter再怎么封装，学习成本还是太高了。
而Meta在全球坐拥35亿社交生态用户，在海外的分量几乎就等同于国内的微信与腾讯生态。
说实话，我觉得OpenClaw能凉成这样，最大的败笔就是被OpenAI招安。
我说Peter，除了Open，跟着OpenAI有啥用啊，它也没能力帮你宣传啊。
要是当初能被被Meta或者老马的X收购，早起飞了，还有别人啥事。
我一直觉得，个人助理这件事，还真只有互联网大厂能干。
一是知道怎么做消费级产品，二是能搭配自家生态，市场教育成本回校特别多。
要是光靠你Codex、Claude Work推，黄花菜都凉了。。。
永远有百分之七八十的人是不会单独再下个Agent APP的。
你看果然吧！Meta自己搞出来之后，华尔街那边，直接瘫软。
投行Truist分析师Youssef Squali在研报中指出：
随着重度用户逐步转向付费订阅，到2030年，Muse有望为Meta带来额外285亿美元的收入。
他将此称为Meta迄今为止建立非广告收入流，最正确的一次尝试。
华尔街给出的11%暴涨，押注的正是这扇刚刚被推开的大门。

Meta’s personal AI agent Muse is only a few weeks old, and the social networking giant isn’t wasting any time building out what may be its biggest bet on consumer AI to date.
CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse.

The Muse agent (the physical avatar is named Jolly, according to Zuckerberg) is designed to handle everyday tasks by connecting to users’ apps and services, including email and calendars. At Connect, Zuckerberg introduced a slew of new capabilities and integrations to make Muse more useful and more deeply woven into users’ daily lives. Muse will be everywhere, if the user chooses, including on their Meta AI glasses.

Muse, which launched in early September, interacts across a user’s devices and digital accounts. The agent is powered by Muse Spark, Meta’s multimodal AI model built for agentic work. Meta has touted it as a more accessible agent than those offered by competitors — an AI helper that, from the jump, allows users to automate the busy work in their lives.

“The centerpiece of our vision for what we’re building is Muse,” Zuckerberg said as he kicked off a keynote donning khakis and a black T-shirt with the words “Building is My love Language” emblazoned across the front. “In the coming years, I expect that Muse is going to grow into the personal superintelligence that billions of people around the world are going to use to accomplish their goals and improve their lives.”
Zuckerberg also believes that Muse will make money for its users — and of course, eventually for Meta.
“We’re standing behind this by making Muse free for a huge number of tokens, with the expectation that over time we will profit by taking a small fee from transactions,” he said.
Here are the new features and capabilities that got our attention …

One of the more fun announcements made Wednesday is that Muse users will soon have the ability to conjure a distinct digital avatar for their particular agent and then video chat with it in real time. A new AI model, Muse Realtime Avatar, has been developed to power the particular feature, the company says.

The idea is that Meta’s previously faceless AI software will be given a face, body, and voice, making them significantly more personable. There’s certainly a hint of Metaverse-ishness to this feature, which was demoed on stage at Connect. Users will be able to have live conversations with this avatar, giving it tasks and asking it questions.

Muse will also be integrated with Meta’s smart glasses line, the company announced. This means that users will be able to communicate with their agent merely by speaking to their glasses. The agent activates via a wake word, the company said, adding that it will be able to guide users through a personalized workout, log meals, book an appointment, and help them buy products they see.
Meta said Muse will work in the background and check back in when it’s done.
It’s not clear exactly when this feature will become available, although Meta says that it should launch sometime in “the coming months.”

Meta says it is bringing Muse computer work to Mac. The company had previously talked about Muse coming to Mac, and spent more time on Wednesday providing a few new details. This means that users will be able to delegate tasks to the agent, and — much like other popular AI agents from OpenAI and Anthropic — Muse will be able to operate any app on a user’s desktop.

“You can have it help you run your small business, or just get work done for you,” Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang said Wednesday during the keynote. “You can walk away from your computer and it keeps working for you on all the jobs you lined up.”

Since Muse will always be working in the background, it will naturally need its own email address. Meta’s Wang announced it is developing that feature and will make it available “soon,” without providing a more precise timeline.
Users will also be able to add Muse to an email thread or forward emails from the agent to handle on their behalf.
Meta has locked in partnerships with companies like Stripe and Shopify, illustrating that the company sees Muse as an important tool for shopping.

Muse can access the entire Shopify product catalog agentically and use Lync and now Shop Pay to buy almost anything on the internet, according to Wang, who noted that Meta has also added more support for payments with PayPal.

The company also announced a string of new partnerships with retailers, including Best Buy, Gap, Sephora, Walmart, and Wayfair. Muse will be able to connect with these retail apps as well as with Expedia and soon, Instacart. Other connectors include GitHub, Granola, and Notion.

Wang noted that the company wants Muse to connect with small business too. Meta recently opened its platform to allow developers to build their own “connectors.” The company received more than 1,500 applications in less than week, he said, adding “I think this could be a generational opportunity to start building for a new platform as it takes off, and the response so far has been really great.”

Meta 的个人人工智能代理 Muse 才诞生几周，这家社交网络巨头并没有浪费任何时间来打造迄今为止在消费者人工智能领域最大的赌注。
周三，首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 为公司在门洛帕克 (Menlo Park) 举行的年度 Connect 活动拉开了帷幕，他的主题演讲明确表明了一件事：Meta 将全力投入 Muse。
Muse 代理（根据扎克伯格的说法，物理头像被命名为 Jolly）旨在通过连接到用户的应用程序和服务（包括电子邮件和日历）来处理日常任务。在 Connect 大会上，扎克伯格推出了一系列新功能和集成，使 Muse 更加有用并更深入地融入用户的日常生活。如果用户选择的话，Muse 将无处不在，包括在他们的 Meta AI 眼镜上。
Muse 于 9 月初推出，可在用户的设备和数字帐户之间进行交互。该代理由 Muse Spark 提供支持，Muse Spark 是 Meta 为代理工作而构建的多模式人工智能模型。 Meta 称其为比竞争对手提供的代理更容易使用的代理——一个人工智能助手，可以让用户从一开始就将生活中繁忙的工作自动化。
“我们所构建的愿景的核心是 Muse，”扎克伯格在主题演讲开始时说道，他身穿卡其裤和黑色 T 恤，正面印有“建筑是我爱的语言”字样。 “在未来的几年里，我预计 Muse 将成长为个人超级智能，全世界数十亿人将利用它来实现他们的目标并改善他们的生活。”
扎克伯格还相信，Muse 将为用户赚钱——当然，最终也为 Meta 赚钱。
他说：“我们通过免费提供大量代币来支持这一点，并期望随着时间的推移，我们将通过从交易中收取少量费用来获利。”
以下是引起我们关注的新特性和功能……
周三发布的更有趣的公告之一是，Muse 用户很快将能够为他们的特定代理召唤一个独特的数字化身，然后与其进行实时视频聊天。该公司表示，已经开发出一种新的人工智能模型 Muse Realtime Avatar 来支持该特定功能。
这个想法是，Meta 之前不露面的人工智能软件将被赋予面孔、身体和声音，使它们变得更加风度翩翩。这个功能肯定有一点元宇宙的味道，它在 Connect 的舞台上进行了演示。用户将能够与该化身进行实时对话，为其分配任务并提出问题。
该公司宣布，Muse 还将与 Meta 的智能眼镜系列集成。这意味着用户只需对着眼镜说话就可以与他们的代理进行交流。该公司表示，该代理通过唤醒词激活，并补充说，它将能够指导用户进行个性化锻炼、记录膳食、预约并帮助他们购买他们看到的产品。
Meta 表示，Muse 将在后台工作，并在完成后回来检查。
目前尚不清楚该功能何时可用，但 Meta 表示该功能应该在“未来几个月”的某个时间推出。
Meta 表示，它将把 Muse 电脑工作带到 Mac 上。该公司此前曾谈论过 Muse 即将登陆 Mac，并在周三花了更多时间提供了一些新细节。这意味着用户将能够将任务委托给代理，并且与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的其他流行人工智能代理非常相似，Muse 将能够操作用户桌面上的任何应用程序。
Meta 的首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 在周三的主题演讲中表示：“你可以让它帮助你经营你的小企业，或者只是帮你完成工作。” “你可以离开电脑，它会继续为你完成你安排的所有工作。”
由于 Muse 始终在后台工作，因此它自然需要自己的电子邮件地址。 Meta 的 Wang 宣布正在开发该功能，并将“很快”推出，但没有提供更准确的时间表。
用户还可以将 Muse 添加到电子邮件线程或转发代理的电子邮件以代表他们处理。
Meta 已与 Stripe 和 Shopify 等公司建立合作伙伴关系，这表明该公司将 Muse 视为重要的购物工具。
Wang 表示，Muse 可以代理访问整个 Shopify 产品目录，并使用 Lync 和现在的 Shop Pay 购买互联网上的几乎任何东西，他指出 Meta 还增加了对 PayPal 付款的更多支持。
该公司还宣布与百思买、Gap、丝芙兰、沃尔玛和 Wayfair 等零售商建立一系列新的合作伙伴关系。 Muse 将能够与这些零售应用程序以及 Expedia 以及即将推出的 Instacart 连接。其他连接器包括 GitHub、Granola 和 Notion。
Wang 指出，该公司也希望 Muse 与小企业建立联系。 Meta 最近开放了其平台，允许开发人员构建自己的“连接器”。他表示，该公司在不到一周的时间里就收到了 1,500 多份申请，并补充道，“我认为这可能是一个世代相传的机会，可以在新平台腾飞之际开始构建它，而且迄今为止的反响非常好。”

cards.title: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
cards.title_cn: Meta 正在制作独立的 Muse AI 小工具
cards.summary: 【Meta】Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent. The product, called Muse Charm, was briefly shown off by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the end of tonight's Meta Connect presentat…
fulltext: The Muse Charm doesn’t require a phone, and it’s supposed to ship this year.

Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent. The product, called Muse Charm, was briefly shown off by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the end of tonight’s Meta Connect presentation. It looks almost like a chunky smartwatch without the strap — just a big screen, plus a little lanyard for carrying the device around.

The Muse Charm has a fingerprint sensor on the top right corner that you can press to activate and begin speaking to the agent. There appears to be a small camera on the device as well, plus what looks like at least three holes for microphones on the front. Zuckerberg said you don’t have to unlock a phone or open an app to use the Charm, but he didn’t share how it’s actually connecting to Meta’s servers.

Meta plans to ship the Charm “in time for the holidays in December,” but as of now Zuckerberg says the company has “only built a few of these so far.” The company still needs to finalize “the finishing material,” he said. Throughout the keynote, he teased the device and made references to a translucent exterior that would let you see the gadget’s internals. He referred to it as an “elevated hacker aesthetic.”
Zuckerberg promised to share more details “soon.”

Muse is less than a month old, but the AI agent has already become a buzzy new product for Meta. The bot is capable of taking actions on a user’s behalf, and Zuckerberg dedicated part of tonight’s keynote to new capabilities Meta is adding to the agent, including computer use on Macs and control over an email address.

There are a lot of companies racing to win the still-undefined and largely experimental realm of AI hardware. The closest analog to the Muse Charm might be the Rabbit R1, a similarly sized cutesy device that housed an AI agent, which was not nearly capable enough to make the product worth carrying around. Connect is nothing if not a reminder of how badly Meta wants to win the race to whatever that next big hardware platform is — it’s moving quickly to see if Muse as a device is something that can stick.

fulltext_cn: Muse Charm 不需要手机，预计今年发货。
Meta 正在为其新的 Muse AI 代理构建专用硬件设备。 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在今晚 Meta Connect 演示结束时简要展示了这款名为 Muse Charm 的产品。它看起来几乎就像一块没有表带的厚实智能手表——只有一个大屏幕，加上一条用于携带设备的小挂绳。
Muse Charm 右上角有一个指纹传感器，您可以按下该传感器来激活并开始与客服人员交谈。该设备上似乎还有一个小型摄像头，前面至少有三个麦克风孔。扎克伯格表示，你不必解锁手机或打开应用程序即可使用 Charm，但他没有透露它实际上是如何连接到 Meta 服务器的。
Meta 计划“在 12 月的假期前”运送 Charm，但扎克伯格表示，该公司“到目前为止只生产了其中的一些”。他说，该公司仍需要最终确定“装饰材料”。在整个主题演讲中，他嘲笑了该设备，并提到了半透明的外观，可以让您看到该设备的内部结构。他将其称为“高尚的黑客审美”。
扎克伯格承诺“很快”分享更多细节。
Muse 推出还不到一个月，但这款 AI 代理已经成为 Meta 的热门新产品。该机器人能够代表用户采取行动，扎克伯格在今晚的主题演讲中专门介绍了 Meta 为该代理添加的新功能，包括在 Mac 上使用计算机和控制电子邮件地址。
有很多公司竞相赢得尚未定义且很大程度上处于实验阶段的人工智能硬件领域。与 Muse Charm 最接近的类似物可能是 Rabbit R1，这是一款类似大小的可爱设备，内部装有人工智能代理，但其功能不足以让该产品值得随身携带。 Connect 如果不能提醒人们 Meta 是多么渴望赢得下一个大型硬件平台的竞争，那么它就没什么意义了——它正在迅速采取行动，看看 Muse 作为一种设备是否能够持久。

The AI amulet has become a bit of a cliché in the tech industry — devices like Friend have turned the idea of physical AI into little more than an exercise in eye-rolling for many consumers.

But that hasn’t stopped Meta from jumping into the arena with its own AI wearable, called Muse Charm, which is designed to give consumers another way to stay connected to its recently launched, and already popular, personal AI agent, Muse.

The device, which CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed in a “one more thing” moment during the company’s annual Connect event, isn’t ready to ship just yet. Zuckerberg said his team had to “finalize laying out the components” and promised the devices would be “ready to ship in time for the holidays in December.”

The Muse agent, which is now embodied by a cute digital avatar known within the company as Jolly, lives inside the palm-sized totem that users can carry in their pockets or attach to a keychain. The device comes with a tiny screen that displays the avatar representing the agent. Users can talk to the device, which can then presumably carry out tasks on their behalf.

“We packed the whole Muse experience, including the whole real-time voice and avatar stack, into something that fits on a keychain and is always available to talk to,” Zuckerberg said during Wednesday’s keynote. “You just go ahead and tap here in the fingerprint sensor in the corner, and you can start talking without having to unlock a phone or open an app.”
Zuckerberg added: “So if you’re not wearing glasses, this is going to be by far the fastest way to talk to your Muse and to show what’s going on around you.”

Appropriate for what it offers, the gadget has a quasi-Tamagotchi feel to it — a lightweight, personality-filled device designed to keep users always connected to Meta’s software. It also feels like a relatviely low-stakes way for the social media giant to experiment with AI wearables while also offering yet another way to distribute its AI agent to the masses.

人工智能护身符在科技行业已经有点陈词滥调了——像 Friend 这样的设备已经把物理人工智能的想法变成了许多消费者的翻白眼练习。
但这并没有阻止 Meta 凭借自己的人工智能可穿戴设备 Muse Charm 进军这个领域，该产品旨在为消费者提供另一种方式与其最近推出的、已经很受欢迎的个人人工智能代理 Muse 保持联系。
首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在公司年度 Connect 活动期间的“另一件事”时刻透露，该设备尚未准备好发货。扎克伯格表示，他的团队必须“最终确定组件的布局”，并承诺这些设备将“在 12 月的假期前及时发货”。
Muse 代理现在由公司内部称为 Jolly 的可爱数字化身体现，位于手掌大小的图腾内，用户可以将其放在口袋中或挂在钥匙链上。该设备配有一个小屏幕，显示代表代理的头像。用户可以与设备交谈，然后设备就可以代表他们执行任务。
扎克伯格在周三的主题演讲中表示：“我们将整个 Muse 体验，包括整个实时语音和头像堆栈，打包到适合钥匙链的东西中，并且随时可以与之交谈。” “你只需点击角落里的指纹传感器，就可以开始通话，而无需解锁手机或打开应用程序。”
扎克伯格补充道：“因此，如果你不戴眼镜，这将是迄今为止与你的缪斯交谈并展示你周围发生的事情的最快方式。”
与它所提供的功能相适应，该小工具有一种类似电子鸡的感觉——一种轻巧、充满个性的设备，旨在让用户始终与 Meta 的软件保持连接。对于这家社交媒体巨头来说，这也是一种相对低风险的方式来尝试人工智能可穿戴设备，同时也提供了另一种向大众分发人工智能代理的方式。

cards.title: Meta is making Muse more powerful and will let you video chat with it, too
cards.title_cn: Meta 使 Muse 变得更加强大，并且还可以让你与它进行视频聊天
cards.summary: 【Meta】Meta is quickly iterating on its new Muse AI agent, announcing a bunch of updates today that make the bot more capable and able to chat with you in more ways. Muse agents are getting their own email a…
fulltext: Muse started as a chatbot but will soon be an AI avatar you can talk with over video.
Meta is quickly iterating on its new Muse AI agent, announcing a bunch of updates today that make the bot more capable and able to chat with you in more ways.

Muse agents are getting their own email addresses that they can use for accomplishing tasks. You’ll also be able to communicate with your Muse agent over the new email addresses, too. In addition, the recently launched Muse Mac app will be getting the ability to use your computer.

Meta is also going to give you another way to chat with its popular AI agent: video calls. Since its recent launch, the primary way to talk with Muse was through a chat interface, but you’ll soon be able to have live video conversations with your Muse avatar. Meta will let you tweak the way your Muse avatar sounds — you can already customize the way it looks — and a new Muse Realtime Avatar model will inform how it moves.

Muse launched earlier this month, and it’s seemingly proving to be a hit, topping the App Store charts and reportedly being downloaded more than ChatGPT on mobile in its first 12 days. Meta appears to be capitalizing on the popularity by quickly introducing the new videocalling features, but that’s not all that’s new for the agent. Meta says it plans to launch Muse on its smart glasses in the coming months, which will let you talk to Muse about what you’re looking at while wearing your glasses.

Last week, Anthropic confirmed that it was operating a wet biology lab in the Bay Area where it uses its AI models to run physical experiments. This week, the AI giant announced that this lab has already made what it believes is a big discovery: a new enzyme “system” that has certain “properties reminiscent of CRISPR,” as Anthropic describes it.
CRISPR is a natural immune system used by bacteria to fight off viruses that has become a gene-editing technology widely used by researchers.

Essentially, what Anthropic says it found is a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages, which are viruses that infect and replicate within bacteria. Anthropic’s researchers say this system behaves similarly to CRISPR in that it can “perform operations like cutting, copying, and pasting DNA.”

It will be up to the broader research community to validate how big, or new, this discovery actually is. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei acknowledges that the discovery was based on the work of others and that a team from Stanford previously discovered a system “that is in some ways similar to the one Claude found,” he wrote on X.
But Amodei and Anthropic are not just emphasizing the discovery. They are touting it was found “mostly, though not entirely, by Claude,” the CEO wrote.

On the one hand, that is astounding. This lab was only established this spring (though Anthropic declined to be more specific about how many months it has been open). A discovery in just a few short months would be speedy enough work, but the team said it actually only took Claude 21 hours of concerted effort. Claude searched through data using about 950 agents that burned through 210 million tokens.

Still, the revelation that Anthropic has been conducting biology experiments comes right after AI CEOs, including Amodei, publicly admitted that models have become so capable, and so potentially dangerous, that the industry must slow down and develop safety-testing procedures. This after a couple of his employees publicly said earlier this month that there’s a risk AI could kill us all.

Amodei himself has said one of the things he fears most is that AI could be used for bioterrorism. But he also believes AI will “cure most diseases in 5-10 years,” he wrote. So Anthropic has clearly decided the rewards are worth the risks.
Given that, perhaps the biggest reveal in this news isn’t the discovery itself but that the biology lab hasn’t let Claude loose. The physical experiments were done by humans.

“Our lab, located in the Bay Area, looks like a typical molecular biology lab. We do research that involves only the lower-levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans. All of the lab work is performed by human scientists.”

It’s also true that AI-powered biological research is hardly unique to Anthropic. Researchers from Stanford just published a paper on the work they are doing with LLMs and CRISPR. Researchers at UC San Francisco used AI to design enzymes from scratch. Google launched its first AI-powered biology research tool, AlphaFold, back in 2020. So AI has clearly arrived in biological research beyond the AI labs pursuing it themselves.

Yet, Amodei hasn’t ruled out a fully automated biology lab in the future. “Eventually it may even be possible for Claude itself to safely perform the experiments by autonomously controlling lab equipment, with appropriate safeguards in place, but we aren’t doing that today,” he said.

上周，Anthropic 证实，它正在湾区运营一个湿生物学实验室，利用其人工智能模型进行物理实验。本周，这家人工智能巨头宣布，该实验室已经取得了它认为的重大发现：一种新的酶“系统”，正如 Anthropic 所描述的那样，它具有某些“让人想起 CRISPR 的特性”。
CRISPR是细菌用来抵抗病毒的天然免疫系统，已成为研究人员广泛使用的基因编辑技术。
从本质上讲，Anthropic 表示，他们发现的是隐藏在噬菌体 DNA 中的一种以前未知的酶系统，噬菌体是感染细菌并在细菌内复制的病毒。 Anthropic 的研究人员表示，该系统的行为与 CRISPR 类似，可以“执行剪切、复制和粘贴 DNA 等操作”。
这将由更广泛的研究界来验证这一发现到底有多大或有多新。 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 承认，这一发现是基于其他人的工作，斯坦福大学的一个团队之前发现了一个系统，“在某些方面与克劳德发现的系统相似，”他在 X 上写道。
但阿莫代和人类并不仅仅强调这一发现。首席执行官写道，他们宣称该发现“主要是由克劳德发现的，尽管不是全部”。
一方面，这是令人震惊的。该实验室于今年春天才成立（尽管 Anthropic 拒绝透露其已开放几个月的具体信息）。短短几个月的发现已经足够快了，但研究小组表示，实际上只花了克劳德 21 个小时的共同努力。 Claude 使用约 950 个代理搜索数据，销毁了 2.1 亿个代币。
尽管如此，在 Anthropic 一直在进行生物学实验的消息曝光之前，包括 Amodei 在内的人工智能首席执行官公开承认，模型已经变得如此强大，并且具有潜在的危险，以至于该行业必须放慢速度并开发安全测试程序。本月早些时候，他的几名员工公开表示，人工智能有可能杀死我们所有人。
阿莫代本人曾说过，他最担心的事情之一是人工智能可能被用于生物恐怖主义。但他也相信人工智能将“在 5-10 年内治愈大多数疾病”，他写道。因此，Anthropic 明确认为回报值得冒险。
鉴于此，这条新闻中最大的揭露也许不是这一发现本身，而是生物实验室并没有释放克劳德。物理实验是由人类完成的。
“我们的实验室位于湾区，看起来像一个典型的分子生物学实验室。我们所做的研究只涉及生物安全风险级别较低的水平（BSL-1和BSL-2），我们不处理可以感染人类的​​病原体。所有实验室工作都是由人类科学家完成的。”
确实，人工智能驱动的生物学研究并不是 Anthropic 所独有的。斯坦福大学的研究人员刚刚发表了一篇关于他们在法学硕士和 CRISPR 方面所做的工作的论文。加州大学旧金山分校的研究人员利用人工智能从头开始设计酶。谷歌早在 2020 年就推出了首款由人工智能驱动的生物学研究工具 AlphaFold。因此，人工智能显然已经进入了人工智能实验室本身之外的生物学研究领域。
然而，阿莫代并没有排除未来建立全自动生物实验室的可能性。 “最终，克劳德自己甚至有可能通过自主控制实验室设备并采取适当的保障措施来安全地进行实验，但我们今天还没有这样做，”他说。
